name: agent.heartbeat rejects intent with control characters
description: intent forbids ASCII control characters (0x00-0x1f, 0x7f) to prevent control-token smuggling per docs/THREAT_MODEL.md section 5.
notes: Sandboxing constraint: free-text fields strip control characters at the schema layer so smuggled tokens never reach a downstream consumer. The BEL byte (U+0007) is JSON-escaped so the fixture file is RFC 8259-conformant; the decoded string still contains the control byte which the #Intent regex rejects.
